FIELDS.NAME: SecureTech Alarm Solutions
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Inspection Coordinator, SecureTech Alarm Solutions, (555) 123-4567, john.smith@securetechalarms.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: SecureTech Alarm Solutions specializes in the installation and maintenance of high-quality alarm systems for residential and commercial properties. Our operations include a comprehensive assessment of client security needs, the design of customized alarm solutions, and meticulous installation processes that adhere to the highest industry standards. We ensure that all installations are reliable, conducting regular maintenance, testing, and monitoring of systems. Our team is trained in safety protocols, and we emphasize the importance of having a well-documented emergency response plan in place. We also maintain strong relationships with reputable alarm system manufacturers to ensure the quality of our products. Continuous risk assessments are conducted to identify and mitigate vulnerabilities, ensuring the safety and confidence of our clients in their alarm systems.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On November 10, 2023, our installation team faced a setback due to an unexpected power surge during the installation of a commercial alarm system, resulting in equipment damage estimated at $1,200. The damaged components have been replaced, and the installation is now complete. Current status: resolved.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday 8:00 AM - 6:00 PM, Saturday 9:00 AM - 2:00 PM
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: UL Class 350, Level 3, Fire Rated Safe
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: 24-hour security monitoring with on-site watchpersons during non-business hours.
